description: Create atomic memory with auto-linking and lifecycle management. Stores single concepts (<400 words).
examples: execute_axmem_tool("create_memory", {"title": "FastAPI auth pattern", "content": "Use JWT with httponly cookies...", "context": "Security decision", "keywords": ["auth", "jwt"], "tags": ["security"], "importance": 9})
name: create_memory

parameters.description: Memory title (max 200 characters)
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Memory content (max 2000 characters, ~300-400 words) - single concept
parameters.example: Selected XTTS-v2 for voice cloning - provides high quality output with low latency
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: WHY this memory matters, HOW it relates, WHAT implications (max 500 characters)
parameters.example: Decision made while implementing voice integration with AI agent
parameters.name: context

parameters.description: Search keywords for semantic matching (max 10, each max 100 characters)
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.description: Categorization tags (max 10, each max 100 characters)
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Score 1-10. 9-10: Personal/foundational, 8-9: Critical solutions, 7-8: Useful patterns, 6-7: Milestones
parameters.name: importance

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

parameters.description: Optional free-form project scope label (max 500 characters); created on first use
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Repository/project source (e.g., 'owner/repo') for provenance tracking
parameters.name: source_repo

parameters.description: Files that informed this memory (list of paths) for provenance tracking
parameters.name: source_files

parameters.description: URL to original source material for provenance tracking
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: Encoding confidence score (0.0-1.0) for provenance tracking
parameters.name: confidence

parameters.description: Agent/process that created this memory for provenance tracking
parameters.name: encoding_agent

parameters.description: Version of encoding process/prompt for provenance tracking
parameters.name: encoding_version

parameters.description: Agent identity for provenance tracking
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: Agent version for provenance tracking
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.description: LLM model used for provenance tracking
parameters.name: agent_model

returns: MemoryCreateResponse with id, title, linked_memory_ids, similar_memories, obsolete_matches

description: Semantic search across memories to find relevant information
name: query_memory

parameters.description: Natural language search query
parameters.example: What did we decide about authentication?
parameters.name: query

parameters.description: Context explaining why you're searching (improves ranking)
parameters.example: Implementing login system for new API
parameters.name: query_context

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

parameters.description: Number of primary results to return (1-20), use INSTEAD of LIMIT
parameters.name: k

parameters.description: Whether to include linked memories for context
parameters.name: include_links

parameters.description: Maximum number of linked memories per primary memory
parameters.name: max_links_per_primary

parameters.description: Minimum importance score (1-10) to include
parameters.name: importance_threshold

parameters.description: Only search memories in this project scope
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: If True, linked memories must also be in the specified project scope
parameters.name: strict_project_filter

returns: MemoryQueryResult with primary_memories, linked_memories, scores, total_count, token_count, truncated flag

description: Update existing memory fields using PATCH semantics (only specified fields are updated)
name: update_memory

parameters.description: ID of the memory to update
parameters.name: memory_id

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

parameters.description: New title (optional)
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: New content (optional)
parameters.name: content

parameters.description: New context (optional)
parameters.name: context

parameters.description: New keywords - replaces existing (optional)
parameters.name: keywords

parameters.description: New tags - replaces existing (optional)
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: New importance score 1-10 (optional)
parameters.name: importance

parameters.description: New project scope label - replaces the existing one; an empty string clears it (optional)
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: New repository/project source. Unchanged if null.
parameters.name: source_repo

parameters.description: New source files list. Replaces existing if provided, unchanged if null.
parameters.name: source_files

parameters.description: New URL to source material. Unchanged if null.
parameters.name: source_url

parameters.description: New encoding confidence score (0.0-1.0). Unchanged if null.
parameters.name: confidence

parameters.description: New agent/process identifier. Unchanged if null.
parameters.name: encoding_agent

parameters.description: New encoding process version. Unchanged if null.
parameters.name: encoding_version

parameters.description: Agent identity for provenance tracking
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.description: Agent version for provenance tracking
parameters.name: agent_version

parameters.description: LLM model used for provenance tracking
parameters.name: agent_model

description: Manually create bidirectional links between memories (symmetric linking). Accepts memory_id + related_ids (or aliases source_id + target_id/target_ids, memory_ids=[src, tgt])
name: link_memories

parameters.description: Source memory ID (aliases: source_id, from_id, id)
parameters.name: memory_id

parameters.description: List of target memory IDs to link (or a single id; aliases: target_id, target_ids, related_id)
parameters.name: related_ids

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

returns: Dict with linked_memory_ids: the target memory IDs that were newly linked (a target that does not exist for the tenant, the source itself and a link that exists already are skipped)

description: Remove bidirectional link(s) between memories. Accepts source_id + target_id (or aliases memory_id + related_id, target_ids, related_ids, memory_ids=[src, tgt, ...])
name: unlink_memories

parameters.description: Source memory ID (aliases: memory_id, from_id, id)
parameters.name: source_id

parameters.description: Target memory ID(s) to unlink (aliases: target_ids, related_id, related_ids, to_id)
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

returns: Dict with 'success' boolean (True if all requested links were removed, False if any link didn't exist)

description: Retrieve complete memory details by ID
name: get_memory

parameters.description: ID of the memory to retrieve
parameters.name: memory_id

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

returns: Complete Memory object with all fields

description: Mark a memory as obsolete (soft delete with audit trail). Restore with unobsolete_memory.
name: mark_memory_obsolete

parameters.description: ID of the memory to mark as obsolete
parameters.name: memory_id

parameters.description: Explanation for why this memory is obsolete
parameters.name: reason

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

parameters.description: Optional ID of the replacement memory
parameters.name: superseded_by

returns: Dict {"success": true} once the memory is marked obsolete; a memory that is not found, is already obsolete or would be superseded by itself is an error, never false

description: Restore a memory previously marked obsolete (undo soft delete)
name: unobsolete_memory

parameters.description: ID of the obsolete memory to restore
parameters.name: memory_id

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

returns: Dict {"success": true} once the memory is active again; a memory that is not found or is not obsolete is an error, never false

description: Retrieve most recent memories sorted by creation timestamp (newest first by default)
name: get_recent_memories

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

parameters.description: Maximum number of memories to return (1-100)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of memories to skip for pagination
parameters.name: offset

parameters.description: Optional filter to one project scope
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Include obsolete memories when true
parameters.name: include_obsolete

parameters.description: Sort field: created_at, updated_at, or importance
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Sort direction: asc or desc
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.description: Optional tag filter (OR semantics when multiple tags)
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Minimum importance (1-10, inclusive)
parameters.name: importance_min

parameters.description: Inclusive ISO 8601 creation timestamp with timezone
parameters.name: created_since

returns: Dictionary with memories list (sorted per sort_by/sort_order) and total_count

description: Rebuild embeddings for a tenant-scoped subset of memories without resetting global vector storage. Targets explicit memory ids, a single project scope, or all caller-owned memories.
name: rebuild_embeddings

parameters.description: FastMCP Context (automatically injected)
parameters.name: ctx

parameters.description: Explicit memory ids owned by the caller; leave null to use project or the whole tenant
parameters.name: memory_ids

parameters.description: Restrict the rebuild to memories in this project scope of the caller
parameters.name: project

returns: Dict with rebuilt_ids (List[str]), skipped_ids (List[str]; edited, made obsolete or deleted while the rebuild ran so the newer state was kept), failed (List[Dict[memory_id, reason]]; reason is embedding_failed, persistence_failed, auto_link_failed or not_found_or_not_owned, the last for an id that does not exist, belongs to another tenant or is obsolete; an auto_link_failed entry also has phase). An unknown project scope is rejected with VALIDATION_ERROR
